notes.title: We Need Reviews!
notes.content:
You bought our game and we love you for it! Now please, pretty please, take the time to review it? 

We know, "*yawn*, writing a game review". It's just another task you didn't need on your to-do list today. We totally get it. But your reviews, be they long and detailed or short and to the point, help us improve as developers, and help other gamers like you find cool stuff on the Steam store. Reviews are really important!

Naturally, we'd really appreciate positive reviews. They're our favourite kind. But if you have constructive criticism for us, we're all ears. 

Thanks for your support guys, and happy gaming!

notes.title: NoReload Heroes 1.1 patch notes
notes.content:
- Improved encounter scaling for 1 & 2 player parties
- Early floors are now somewhat shorter (fewer rooms until teleporter)
	- This is meant to speed up the early game for more experienced players
	- Total amount of loot & experience is still the same
- Refino-bot boss has to cool down a bit more between attacks
- Dead enemies drop their loot a bit faster
- Fixed some issues in online play
	- Fixed a bug that prevented starting a party game from the online lobby

Happy gaming!
